apps.label: Applications
apps.title: Applications for Magic Rampage
apps.description: Third-party applications for Magic Rampage that help players work with equipment and experiment with builds.

paragraphs: There are third-party applications for Magic Rampage that help players experiment with equipment and better understand the game. Among them are Magic Rampage: Companion and Inventory Rampager.
Their main concept is similar: both allow players to work with in-game equipment and test different builds without spending game resources directly in the game.
Magic Rampage: Companion is a companion application created to help players progress through the game.

It allows players to test game equipment before purchasing it and also contains additional information that can be useful during gameplay: secret areas, ways to obtain tokens, and secret achievements.
Its main feature is the combination of equipment management with additional information about the game itself.
Inventory Rampager is an inventory simulator and a tool for creating builds.

The application allows players to view equipment, freely change its level, change the character class, activate Skill Tree abilities, use tonics from the Tavern, and calculate stats. It also includes a function for automatically finding a suitable equipment set.
The main focus is specifically on experimenting with builds and character stats.
Both applications are suitable if you want to experiment with equipment and test different builds in advance. The difference is mainly in their additional purpose:
list: Magic Rampage: Companion — a more universal option if, besides working with equipment, you are interested in secrets, achievements, and other gameplay information.
Inventory Rampager — an option for those who primarily want to work with builds, equipment, and character stats.

paragraphs: Thus, if you need a companion and a game guide, you may want to look at Magic Rampage: Companion. If you need a tool for experimenting with builds, you can choose Inventory Rampager.
